## Create Your Template Shop as The New Year Starts

Have you made up your mind yet?

What side hustle will you be starting to make passive income in 2024?

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Photo by BoliviaInteligente on Unsplash

Are you going to take my advice and start your Canva template shop or do you have something else in mind?

Well, if creating a Canva template shop is on your to-do list for 2024, then this story is for you.

Now, while selling Canva templates can be very profitable, they can also be a complete waste of time.

If you doubt me, try launching a Canva template shop with random templates and shabby keyword research.

Then you’ll know what crickets in a store look like.

So what makes the difference?

> Why do some Canva template shops fail while others end up becoming super profitable?

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Photo by Anthony Tran on Unsplash

Well, it’s the niche that makes the difference.

Yes, your Canva template niche will determine

- how many people see your product listing
- and how profitable your shop becomes.

So the wrong niche brings crickets while the perfect niche brings passive income.

## But What Makes for the Perfect Niche?

First , the perfect niche is the niche where you get the most bucks for your time input.

It’s that niche you create templates for and can almost predict will make you a sale.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Photo by Blogging Guide on Unsplash

Finding profitable Canva Niches is easy when you focus on these two qualities:

- High Demand
- Low competition: less than 1000–1500 search results

So for every niche you decide to create templates on shop for, remember to make sure they have these two qualities.

> Now I already did the work and found 3 of the most profitable niches to create template shops for in 2024.

You heard that right?

Today’s story isn’t another keyword research tutorial where I show you how to catch the big fishes.

Today, I’ll be straight up giving you the fish you need to launch your super profitable Canva template shop.

For each of the niches on this list, I'll tell you

- why selling templates in that niche is super profitable
- and then I’ll give you the exact Keywords you need to create templates in that niche.

## Niche No 1: The Photography Niche

The first niche I found for a profitable Canva shop is the photographer niche.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Photo by Lilly Rum on Unsplash

Now I won’t even lie, photography is a lot of work.

And finding the perfect angle, preset and background ain’t child’s play.

The complexity of this skill I believe is what makes it so profitable.

According to salary.com, the average photographer makes over $71,366 per year.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Screenshot of Salary.com on Google

And with this kind of revenue comes the need for a lot of resources.

Think about it: the only thing these photographers know how to do is take photos

But is that all that goes into running a successful photography business?

Definitely not.

There’s the

- Branding
- Marketing
- Onboarding
- and Organization aspect of things

All of these elements are what makes for a truly successful photography business.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Photo by Dariusz Sankowski on Unsplash

Now, because these photographers aren’t familiar with these business details, they go looking for easy-to-use templates to get the job done themselves.

And that’s where we, come in.

The photography niche is super in demand yet while doing my research for this niche, I found so many keywords with very low competition.

> If you’re considering this niche for your template shop, here are the specific keywords you could try for creating passive income templates especially on Etsy

- Photographer planner 2024: 688 search results
- photography portfolio book: 1,103 search results
- boudoir welcome guide: 836 search results
- boudoir contract: 912 search results

These keywords have super low competition and if you launch your shop properly, you should be able to make your first sale even as a beginner.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Screenshot of email by Author

## Niche No 2: Virtual Assistant

Another niche I found for a profitable Canva template shop was the virtual assistant niche.

Now, a virtual assistant is a freelancer that handles the backend day to day tasks of small business owners.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Photo by LinkedIn Sales Solutions on Unsplash

It's a very profitable service but comes with a lot of time commitment.

These VAs have to deal with everything from

- Content Creation
- Data entry
- Marketing
- and any other important organization task.

So isn’t it obvious why they need Canva templates to run their business smoothly?

I can’t even lie, the demand for templates in this niche is super easy to see.

Looking at the competition in this niche, I found some great keywords that work well for a new template shop, especially if you’re just starting out.

- virtual assistant starter kit
- virtual assistant portfolio template
- virtual assistant agreement
- virtual assistant contract

## Niche No 3: The Author Niche

Now, here’s a quick question I need to get off my chest.

Do you think I deserve to call myself an author?

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Photo by Cathryn Lavery on Unsplash

Sure, I write stories and ebooks but it still feels too much adding the tag 'Author to my credentials.

That's because I'm yet to go through what real authors face.

- writers block
- unfinished books
- bad launches and all of that.

But that said, all these downsides of being an author is what makes this niche super profitable to sell templates in.

These authors are already juggling a lot with writing books and don’t have the bandwidth for other aspects of managing their business.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Photo by Ryan Snaadt on Unsplash

And most authors I know would rather outsource their

- Branding
- Marketing
- Launches
- Design and more to professional freelancers or DIY these tasks using Canva templates

So, I want you to

- think about any template that meets the needs of these authors,
- and create as many as you can.

As promised, I did my research and found some keywords you can start out to sell templates on Etsy

- book launch release template: 912 search results
- book launch flyer: 982 search results
- author digital planner: 1,364 search results
- Author Newsletters: 936 search results

## Quick Note

Before we end today’s story and the last story for the year, I need you to see what makes these three niches particularly appealing.

> Well, they all belong to a broader category; small businesses.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Photo by Patrick Tomasso on Unsplash

### But why does that even matter?

Because these three profitable niches all focus on the same target audience of small business owners, there’s no need to set up separate shops for your templates.

Yes, you can simply

- create one Etsy shop catering to small business owners
- and upload templates on all of the keywords I’ve listed in this story.

In fact, I found a shop on Etsy doing the exact thing and the income they generate is truly amazing.

This shop has templates for every small business you can think of.

- Coffee shops
- Photographers
- Content Creators
- Coaches
- Wedding Planners
- Interior designers and much more.

With the lucrative potential of the small business owner niche, this shop has received a remarkable 58,987 sales and consistently gets new reviews nearly every day.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Screenshot of ShopRShop On Etsy

At an average of $5.40, ShopRShop has easily made $318529 in total revenue.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

Screenshot by Author

So if you’re thinking about starting a small business template shop similar to ShopRShop, this niche is perfect for beginners.

> Because small business owners would rather have templates do the work while they handle their real business.

The best part is you can find even more content ideas by asking ChatGPT for

- 10–20 small businesses niches

Press enter or click to view image in full size

ChatGPT Dashboard

- And then ask for 10–20 template ideas these businesses need.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

ChatGPT Dashboard

## Conclusion

As I conclude this last story of the year 2023, I’d like to commend you on your journey so far.

With 2023 behind us, let’s now plan for a better 2024.

- Try a profitable side hustle
- Learn a new skill
- Take action on your goals
- Just do something

A wise man once said: Insanity is doing the same thing while hoping for a different outcome.

So in 2024, don’t be a doubting Thomas.

Build your first template shop on Etsy at least, because you really have nothing to lose.

I’m saying this because I truly want many of you to feel what it’s like to make passive income.

And to make the entire process of setting up your Canva template shop super easy, I launched a Canva starter kit.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

The Canva Income Starter Kit

The Canva Income Starter Kit is an All in One kit for beginners looking to launch a profitable Canva template shop in 2024.

It has all my templates and checklists for launching and growing profitable Canva template shops on different marketplaces.

This includes:

- A Canva shop branding kit with banners and logo templates to make buyers fall in love with your shop.
- A Template Upload kit with over 40 Product photo template and deliverables to create very attractive product listings
- and 2 beginner checklists to help you take your shop from zero to your very first sale even as a beginner.

So if you’ve tried selling Canva Templates on Etsy or other marketplaces before, this is your sign to go again.

> Because the Canva Income Starter Kit is the Canva passive income bestie I wish I had when I first started.
